In 2018, the Boston Red Sox won the World Series against Los Angeles Dodgers. So answer: Boston Red Sox.

Alternatively, it might ask about "world championships" such as FIBA basketball world cup etc. But typical phrase "世界大賽" often means "World Championship". Could also mean "World Championships" in track and field? Not sure.

But given common knowledge, I'd respond with Boston Red Sox winning the 2018 MLB World Series.
